# apipbx_blacklist_settings (Resource)

A tenant's blacklist settings (one per tenant). Destroying it restores the defaults. Import with the tenant id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `block_unknown` (Boolean) Also divert calls whose caller id is withheld.
- `destination_id` (String)
- `destination_type` (String) Where diverted calls go: extension, ring_group, voicemail, time_condition, ivr, queue, conference, announcement, misc_destination, set_caller_id, paging_group, voicemail_group, disa or hangup.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
